# SALARYMAN

> SALARYMAN is a browser-based work simulation game and AI-powered business operating system. Players build companies, manage teams, earn in-game currency, and access real productivity tools — all inside a retro-pixel city.

SALARYMAN combines an AI business assistant (Pablo), a persistent pixel-art city world, and a full suite of business tools (invoicing, hiring, contracts, payroll, CRM, and more) into a single gamified platform. It is designed for entrepreneurs, freelancers, and small teams who want to run their business and play at the same time.
